Develop IP-addressing plans and routing policies using technologies such as BGP, OSPF, IPv4, IPv6, ECMP, and high-availability routing. Support modular region deployment and expansion by developing repeatable network designs, configuration models, validation procedures, and operational standards. Integrate physical network infrastructure with cloud virtual networking, service connectivity, and overlay architectures. Produce clear design documents, diagrams, deployment specifications, runbooks, decision records, and leadership-ready status updates. Strong understanding of Layer 2 through Layer 4 networking, IP addressing and subnetting, BGP, OSPF, IPv4, IPv6, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, ECMP, and high-availability design. Experience designing, deploying, or operating data-center, cloud, service-provider, or large-enterprise networks. Hands-on experience automating network provisioning, configuration, validation, or operations using Python or another programming language. Experience with Git, APIs, CI/CD workflows, automated testing, configuration modeling, or infrastructure-as-code practices. Experience executing production network changes with appropriate risk assessment, validation, rollback, and change-management controls. Demonstrated troubleshooting skills across network protocols, devices, automation systems, and physical infrastructure. Experience participating in incident response, root-cause analysis, operational readiness, and continuous-improvement efforts. Ability to work independently, manage project milestones and dependencies, and coordinate effectively with adjacent engineering and operations teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical designs, runbooks, and project updates. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or operating hyperscale cloud, service-provider, ISP, or large-scale data-center networks. Proven experience partnering with cloud networking and platform teams to integrate virtual network services with physical underlay infrastructure in large-scale overlay environments. Experience with Clos or spine-leaf fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, SDN overlays, traffic engineering, segmentation, and secure service connectivity. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF, gNMI, or comparable model-driven networking technologies. Experience implementing network telemetry and observability using SNMP, streaming telemetry, NetFlow/IPFIX, flow logs, dashboards, alerting, and service-level indicators. Knowledge of network-security principles, including ACL and routing-policy management, least privilege, segmentation, MACsec, IPsec, and TLS. Experience with commodity Ethernet platforms, optics, structured cabling, hardware qualification, and network operating-system validation. Experience improving operational workflows through automated validation, reusable runbooks, deployment guardrails, or configuration-drift detection. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve automation, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, or operational efficiency. Intervenir sur les équipements de téléphonie, les terminaux mobiles et les systèmes de communication des établissements. Participer à la préparation des achats, au suivi des matériels et à la gestion des stocks. Réaliser les interventions techniques nécessaires à l'intégration de nouveaux équipements et services. Accompagner les opérations de maintenance et de mise à jour des applications métiers sur leurs aspects techniques. Rédiger et actualiser les procédures, documentations et consignes d'exploitation. Vous occuperez un poste polyvalent, offrant une réelle autonomie et la possibilité de contribuer directement à la qualité des services informatiques indispensables aux professionnels du soin et de l'accompagnement. review_candidates.description: Role Description We are seeking technically skilled and security-focused professionals for the positions of Telecommunications Engineer / Cybersecurity Engineer . These roles focus on telecommunications infrastructure, network engineering, information security, system protection, and the development of reliable and secure technology solutions. Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection systems, encryption, and network security controls. Understanding of cybersecurity risk assessment, vulnerability management, and incident response. Knowledge of network monitoring, troubleshooting, and system performance evaluation. Familiarity with relevant tools, technologies, and industry security standards. Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Security+, CEH, or equivalent are advantageous. Strong analytical, technical problem-solving, and communication abilities. High attention to detail and commitment to network reliability, information security, and continuous improvement.
